policy.name: Door and window sentinel
policy.lesson: Two ways out, so I hold both: the door below and the window above, ignoring noise.

reply:
I loaded the skill and applied its main rule: stand at the chokepoints instead of sweeping the floor. This round has two chokepoints, the front door and the window directly above it. The patrol therefore loops between the door area on the ground floor and the window on the upper floor, using the stairs near the entrance. A dwell of 2 seconds keeps him standing at each post. Skepticism 2 stops decoys from pulling him away. I'm leaving protectRelic off because he would probably reach the vault after the thief does, and it would leave both exits open.

```json
{
  "name": "Door and window sentinel",
  "decoySkepticism": 2,
  "protectRelic": false,
  "dwell": 2,
  "patrol": [
    { "x": 3, "y": 18 },
    { "x": 5, "y": 18 },
    { "x": 18, "y": 10 },
    { "x": 20, "y": 10 }
  ],
  "lesson": "Two ways out, so I hold both: the door below and the window above, ignoring noise."
}
```
